meta.title: Pasado hipotético
meta.goal: Ya puedes usar tercer condicional en ejemplos claros y adecuados al contexto.

cards.title: Pasado hipotético: qué expresa
cards.lede: Esta lección te ayuda a usar tercer condicional con precisión y sin traducir palabra por palabra.

rows.value: Had I known, I would have...

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer la intención y elegir correctamente tercer condicional en situaciones reales.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la forma completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo como una unidad completa y fíjate en la posición de las palabras.

rows.value: If I'd known, I'd have called.
She might have passed if she'd studied.
Had we left earlier, we'd have arrived on time.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: La elección depende de la intención, la cantidad, el tiempo o el registro.

columns.label: if + past perfect
examples: If I'd known, I'd have called.

columns.label: would have + participio
examples: She might have passed if she'd studied.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con una forma natural y gramatical.

lines.text: If I would have known, I called.
If I had known, I would have called.

cards.title: Decisión en cuatro pasos
cards.lede: Usa esta lista para comprobar tu frase antes de continuar.

rows.value: Elige la forma adecuada de tercer condicional.
Revisa sujeto, verbo, número y tiempo.
Lee la frase completa y evita traducir literalmente.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: crea una frase personal con cada patrón y léela en voz alta.

quiz.q: If they had left, they ___ arrived.
quiz.explain: La respuesta correcta aplica la regla central de tercer condicional.

options: If I would have known, I called.
If I had known, I would have called.
quiz.explain: La segunda opción usa la estructura y el orden correctos.

quiz.q: ¿Qué conviene revisar al usar tercer condicional?
options: La intención, la estructura y el contexto.
Solo la traducción literal al español.
quiz.explain: Una frase natural depende del significado, la forma y el contexto, no de traducir palabra por palabra.

transform.source: I didn't study, so I failed the driving test.
transform.instruction: Reescribe la oración en tercer condicional usando la palabra clave.
accept: If I had studied, I would have passed the driving test.

transform.source: She didn't set an alarm, so she missed her flight.
transform.instruction: Reescribe la oración usando tercer condicional con la palabra clave.
accept: If she had set an alarm, she wouldn't have missed her flight.
If she had set an alarm, she would not have missed her flight.

transform.source: We arrived late because we took the wrong train.
transform.instruction: Reescribe en tercer condicional con la palabra clave.
accept: If we hadn't taken the wrong train, we would have arrived on time.
If we had not taken the wrong train, we would have arrived on time.

transform.source: He didn't wear a coat, so he caught a bad cold.
transform.instruction: Reescribe usando la palabra clave entre paréntesis.
accept: If he had worn a coat, he wouldn't have caught a cold.
If he had worn a coat, he would not have caught a cold.
If I had known about the traffic, I would have left twenty minutes earlier.
She would have finished the project on time if she had received the client feedback.
If you had warned us about the storm, we wouldn't have gone sailing yesterday.

correct.sentence: If I would have seen you, I would have said hello.
accept: If I had seen you, I would have said hello.
correct.explanation: En la condición se usa past perfect (had seen), nunca would have.

correct.sentence: If they had asked for directions, they wouldn't have gotten lost.
accept: If they had asked for directions, they wouldn't have gotten lost.

correct.sentence: If she had listened to the advice, she had avoided the problem.
accept: If she had listened to the advice, she would have avoided the problem.
correct.explanation: El resultado requiere would have + participio.

correct.sentence: Had we known the flight was cancelled, we would have stayed at the hotel.
accept: Had we known the flight was cancelled, we would have stayed at the hotel.
correct.explanation: La inversión formal con Had en tercer condicional es correcta.

correct.sentence: If he studied harder last year, he would have passed the exam.
accept: If he had studied harder last year, he would have passed the exam.
correct.explanation: Para una situación hipotética del pasado se usa past perfect (had studied).

personalize.promptEs: Piensa en una decisión importante del pasado. ¿Cómo habría sido diferente tu vida si hubieras tomado otra decisión?
personalize.starter: If I had chosen a different path, I would have
personalize.hintEs: Escribe 2 o 3 oraciones usando If I had (not) + participio, I would (not) have + participio.

personalize.promptEs: ¿Qué habría ocurrido si hubieras aprendido inglés a una edad más temprana?
personalize.starter: If I had learned English earlier, I would have
personalize.hintEs: Escribe tus ideas en pasado hipotético.

personalize.promptEs: Recuerda un momento de suerte o coincidencia. ¿Qué habría pasado sin esa casualidad?
personalize.starter: If that coincidence had not happened, I would have
personalize.hintEs: Usa la estructura de tercer condicional.
